params.body:
The owner's agents (a workbench session, the voice) can now read the platform's usage figures on a read mandate (layer B1, control `docs/mandates.md`), the way they already read the Gentells pipeline. Nothing is written and nothing passes the gateway; every answer is a count.

## What it adds

- `GET /api/control/tools` lists five read tools with their JSON schemas; `GET /api/control/tools/{name}?args=<json>` answers one.
  - `usage`: every measure against the period before, how many different people signed in, and what is not counted.
  - `measure`: one measure, as a total, over time, per weekday or per hour.
  - `traffic`: cars looked at per channel (own sites, widget, platform, widget opens, buy-overs).
  - `listings`: cars entered, offers, orders, leads, bids, lookups, photos, and car sheets edited.
  - `errors`: error rates of the partner API, partner deliveries, webhooks and background jobs.
- `ReadMandate` checks the owner's mandate (B1, `stocklist.read` on `stocklist:platform`, not expired, naming the agent) and the agent's own Ed25519 signature over method, path with query, time and nonce, against the DID document `Mandate` already reads. A nonce counts once. The same checks the pipeline makes for its reads.
- Each tool calls `Measures`, `Activity`, `ActivityEvents` or `Operations`, so a measure means what it means on Inzichten and Werking, with the same staff filter. No answer carries a garage name, a person or a car: the partner API is given without its garages, deliveries without their cars, failed jobs without their exception text.
- Searches are not counted on the platform; `usage` says so under `not_counted` instead of answering zero.
- A wrong question gets 422 with what can be asked; an answer that could not be read gets 503 and is reported, not zeroed.

## Notes for review

- The two read routes are registered before the partner API group: its catch-all `{table}/{id?}` would otherwise take `GET /api/control/tools` and ask for a partner token.
- The signature covers the raw `QUERY_STRING`, not Laravel's re-encoded query, so it holds for what the client actually sent.
- Rules R P3-17.5 to 17.7; page `docs/api/control-reads.md` with the tools, arguments and example questions; `DocsMatchRoutesTest` now pins that page to the routes.
- Needs Portal to issue `stocklist.read` for B1 (abovebeyond-ai/portal, separate PR) before any read is answered; until then every read is refused with the reason.

## Tests

- `ControlReadTest`: mandated and signed reads list and answer; each refusal by its reason (stranger key, not B1, wrong kind or resource, expired, other agent, stale, wrong path signed, nonce reused); every tool answers in its window; no answer names a garage or a person; wrong questions get what can be asked.
- Full suite, PHPStan and Pint on the added files run locally.
params.title: Usage figures for the owner's agents on a read mandate (B1)
